$comment: Dated country-risk tables used by the country_risk check. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Update the as_of dates when you refresh a table.

eu_high_risk_third_countries.source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1675 as amended by (EU) 2025/1184, (EU) 2026/46 and (EU) 2026/83

fatf_increased_monitoring.source: FATF, Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring (grey list), plenary statement of 19 June 2026. Next plenary 26-30 October 2026.

fatf_call_for_action.source: FATF, High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action (black list), 19 June 2026

eu_comprehensive_sanctions_regimes.source: EU sanctions regimes with broad sectoral or financial restrictions (Regulations (EU) 833/2014 and 269/2014 Russia, (EC) 765/2006 Belarus, (EU) 267/2012 Iran, (EU) 2017/1509 DPRK, (EU) 36/2012 Syria). Country-level block for an unlicensed payroll flow; individual designations are screened separately.

fx_static_fallback.$comment: Last-resort mid rates (EUR per 1 unit of currency) used only when Tatum and Frankfurter are both unreachable. Cross-rated from the CNB fixing of 2026-10-16 (EUR 24.325 CZK). Always reported as warn, never as pass.
fx_static_fallback.source: CNB daily fixing 2026-10-16, cross-rated to EUR
